## Public-release safety checklist

- [ ] No `.env` file or environment-variable value
- [ ] No API key, access token, password, private key, or database URL
- [ ] No Shopify secret or supplier credential
- [ ] No merchant or customer data
- [ ] No private production source copied from Shop Boost Labs application repositories
- [ ] Any screenshot or video has been visually checked for sensitive information
- [ ] Links point only to intended public destinations
